## Message

```
[X18N4006] Key not found <detail>
├▶ fix: List keys with `x18n keys` (agents: the `x18n_keys` tool).
╰▶ see: https://x18n.antfu.dev/errors/x18n4006
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

The key does not exist in any locale.

1. Run `x18n keys` to list the keys, or `x18n keys "<glob>"` to search.
2. Check the namespace. In a namespaced project the key is `ns:path`, for example `common:save`.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `1`.
